note: Construction accepts one or more plaintext seeds, validates every confirmed nonzero response identity, skips per-seed RPC/header/zero-ID/incomplete-topology observations, and retains the last complete same-cluster GetMembers snapshot. Foreground refresh tries every known URL without erasing the last complete snapshot, normalizes/sorts/deduplicates member URLs, and records the leader. Background update/health loops, callbacks, TLS, forwarding, and service-mode changes remain external.
